properties.displayName: UAV S19 - Failsafe Parameter Unauthorized Modification (FS_* to 0)
properties.description: UAVConfigAudit_CL에서 FS_* 파라미터가 0으로 설정되거나 이전 값 대비 50% 이하로 감소 탐지. 실제 컬럼: ParamValueBefore/ParamValueAfter(Double). MITRE: T0838 Modify Alarm Settings (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let fsParams = dynamic(["FS_THR_ENABLE","FS_GCS_ENABLE","FS_EKF_ACTION","FS_CRASH_CHECK","FS_LAND_AERR"]);
UAVConfigAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where ParamId in (fsParams)
| extend isDisabling = ParamValueAfter == 0
    or (isnotnull(ParamValueBefore) and ParamValueBefore > 0 and ParamValueAfter < ParamValueBefore * 0.5)
| where isDisabling
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("Failsafe_파라미터_비활성화_", ParamId, "_", tostring(ParamValueBefore), "→", tostring(ParamValueAfter))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, ParamId, ParamValueBefore, ParamValueAfter, Source, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S19 - Failsafe Parameter Unauthorized Modification (FS_* to 0) - {{UAVId}}
